description: Substrate helpers: op=ss58_decode (address → account public key hex + network prefix), ss58_encode (account hex + prefix → address), ss58_convert (address + prefix → same account under another network), storage_key (account address → System.Account storage key hex), decode_account_info (SCALE hex → nonce/balances), blake2b (hex data, out_len bytes 1-64, optional personal), twox128 (text). Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: substrate_tool
title: Polkadot / Substrate SS58, storage keys, hashes (dev tool)
